# OpenAPI ToolRouter Benchmark

Reusable OpenAPI tool-routing benchmark and practical SaaStoAgent-style API
router harness. The primary product-readiness path evaluates natural user
queries, top-k recovery, follow-up decisions, unsafe-write blocking, and
feedback learning. The graph/RAG/GRAG research harness remains available as a
separate benchmark surface.

## Boundary

- OpenAPI specs are the routing source of truth.
- Parsing and validation use open-source libraries: `prance`,
  `openapi-spec-validator`, and `openapi-core`.
- Custom code focuses on normalized endpoint extraction, graph generation, RAG
  generation, routing baselines, task generation, evaluation, and reports.
- Medusa-specific endpoint mappings, routing rules, stopword lists, action
  lexicons, and business policy are not encoded.
- Write operations are dry-run routing/schema candidates only.
- Raw OpenAPI specs remain the routing source. Repaired specs are generated only
  for strict validation and record non-semantic default removals in
  `artifacts/repair_manifest.json`.
- Product-readiness reports keep natural routing, recovery follow-up, and
  low-overlap stress metrics separate.
- Research reports still group graph-enriched RAG (`grag_expand`,
  `grag_rerank`, `grag_constrained`) ahead of `rag_all_max`, `bm25_all_max`,
  and `graph_sparse` ablations.

## Commands

```powershell
python -m toolrouter fetch-medusa-specs --out data/openapi/
python -m toolrouter ingest --openapi data/openapi/medusa_admin.yaml --openapi data/openapi/medusa_store.yaml --out artifacts/
python -m toolrouter tasks --artifacts artifacts/ --coverage data/medusa_task_coverage.json --task-prefix medusa --out data/medusa_tasks.json --min-count 100
python -m toolrouter split-tasks --tasks data/medusa_tasks.json --out data/medusa_task_splits.json
python -m toolrouter task-audit --tasks data/medusa_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --splits data/medusa_task_splits.json --out reports/task_audit/
python -m toolrouter leakage-audit --tasks data/medusa_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --out reports/leakage_audit/
python -m toolrouter benchmark --tasks data/medusa_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --splits data/medusa_task_splits.json --out results.json
python -m toolrouter report --results results.json --out reports/
python -m toolrouter medusa-smoke --creds ../../test_targets/CREDS.md --base-url http://localhost:9000 --out medusa_smoke_result.json
```

Product-readiness Medusa run:

```powershell
python -m toolrouter natural-tasks --artifacts artifacts/ --coverage data/medusa_task_coverage.json --task-prefix medusa_nat --out data/medusa_natural_tasks.json --min-count 100
python -m toolrouter recovery-tasks --artifacts artifacts/ --coverage data/medusa_task_coverage.json --task-prefix medusa_rec --out data/medusa_recovery_tasks.json
python -m toolrouter split-tasks --tasks data/medusa_natural_tasks.json --tasks data/medusa_recovery_tasks.json --out data/medusa_product_task_splits.json
python -m toolrouter benchmark --mode product_readiness --tasks data/medusa_natural_tasks.json --tasks data/medusa_recovery_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --splits data/medusa_product_task_splits.json --synthetic-feedback --out results_product_readiness.json
python -m toolrouter report --results results_product_readiness.json --out reports/
```

Product reports generated by that flow:

- `reports/product_readiness.md`
- `reports/natural_routing.md`
- `reports/recovery_followup.md`
- `reports/decision_calibration.md`
- `reports/feedback_learning.md`

The `--synthetic-feedback` flag writes offline experiment artifacts only:

- `data/synthetic_feedback_events.jsonl`
- `artifacts/synthetic_feedback_ranker.joblib`
- `artifacts/synthetic_feedback_ranker.manifest.json`

These synthetic outputs are generated from benchmark corrections and are not
runtime feedback claims.

Feedback-aware runtime routing:

```powershell
python -m toolrouter train-feedback --feedback data/feedback_events.jsonl --artifacts artifacts/ --out artifacts/feedback_ranker.joblib
python -m toolrouter route --query "start a checkout for a shopper" --artifacts artifacts/ --feedback-log data/feedback_events.jsonl --feedback-model artifacts/feedback_ranker.joblib
```

Leakage-reduced Medusa suite:

```powershell
python -m toolrouter low-overlap-tasks --artifacts artifacts/ --coverage data/medusa_task_coverage.json --task-prefix medusa_low --out data/medusa_low_overlap_tasks.json --min-routing 100 --min-ambiguous 50 --min-policy 50
python -m toolrouter split-tasks --tasks data/medusa_low_overlap_tasks.json --out data/medusa_low_overlap_task_splits.json
python -m toolrouter task-audit --tasks data/medusa_low_overlap_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --splits data/medusa_low_overlap_task_splits.json --out reports/low_overlap/task_audit/
python -m toolrouter leakage-audit --tasks data/medusa_low_overlap_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --out reports/low_overlap/leakage_audit/
python -m toolrouter benchmark --tasks data/medusa_low_overlap_tasks.json --artifacts artifacts/ --splits data/medusa_low_overlap_task_splits.json --out results_low_overlap.json
python -m toolrouter report --results results_low_overlap.json --out reports/low_overlap/
```

The low-overlap report groups graph-enriched RAG baselines first and includes
track-aware metrics for routing-only accuracy, ambiguous abstention, policy
abstention, macro average by track, and low/medium/high overlap buckets.
